titleText.es: Los contenidos de cualquier viñeta son dependientes de los contenidos de todas las viñetas incluyendo a ella misma. El grafo de las dependencias entre viñetas es completo y bidireccional, y cada nodo tiene un ciclo. Este texto tiene doscientos setenta y tres caracteres.
titleText.en: The contents of any one panel are dependent on the contents of every panel including itself. The graph of panel dependencies is complete and bidirectional, and each node has a loop. The mouseover text has two hundred and forty-two characters.
titleText.noteEn: The Spanish text is the exact title attribute in the Spanish archive; the English text is the exact official xkcd title attribute, whose stated character count intentionally differs.

cardDefinitions.noteEn: Viñeta can also mean a small illustration or vignette. As a comics term, it names one framed panel of a comic strip.

example.es: La primera viñeta no tiene diálogo.
example.en: The first comic panel has no dialogue.

cardDefinitions.promptEs: porción · cantidad · posición · viñetas dentro de la imagen
cardDefinitions.answerEn: each panel measures the same image, and the position panel contains smaller copies of all three panels
cardDefinitions.noteEn: The strip is self-describing: one panel labels the white and black portions, another graphs black ink by panel, and the last plots where that ink appears. Because the final plot contains thumbnails of the panels, its own content contributes recursively to the quantities and positions it depicts.
